verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an official REST API with a rendered OpenAPI 3.0 reference, an embedded machine-readable spec, and a dated versioning policy, so developers can build against it or generate their own clients. However, no official language SDK or client library is evidenced, so the story is met only through raw HTTP or self-generated code. Missing for 10: official SDK packages in any language, SDK docs/install instructions, a downloadable raw OpenAPI spec URL for codegen, independent corroboration.
